Definition: properly, to adhere to; hence, to await
BiblicalUsage: 1) to wait, wait for, await; 1a) (Qal) to wait for; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to wait, tarry; 1b2) to wait (in ambush); 1b3) to wait for, long for
